name: Cartridge brass CuZn30 (70/30), the bronze family's declared accent
summary: A wrought yellow brass of 70 parts copper to 30 parts zinc (UNS C26000 'Cartridge Brass, 70%'; EN CW505L CuZn30). It is a single-phase brass that works well cold and is made as sheet, strip, rod, tube and wire, so it is the metal of the woven mesh of the Reserve's racks and of small brushed fittings. It is a copper alloy and ages like the bronze, but it is yellower: it is declared as an accent of the bronze family, never a second bronze.

identity.class: metal, copper alloy, alpha brass (single-phase Cu-Zn solid solution)

designations.source: Copper Development Association, 'Copper Brass Bronze Design Handbook: Architectural Applications' (A4039), Table 1 ('C26000, Cartridge Brass, 70%: 70% copper, 30% zinc'), https://www.copper.org/publications/pub_list/pdf/A4039-ArchitecturalApplications.pdf
EN 1412 'Copper and copper alloys - European numbering system' (CW505L = CuZn30); the European equivalent of C26000
designations.note: The text of EN 1412 was not read (the standard is sold, not published); CW505L is the European number under which CuZn30 is traded. No number in this record depends on it.

whyAnAccent.text: Decision D-014 reads the boards' brass as a declared accent of the bronze family: one bronze, and brass only where a wrought yellow copper alloy is the real material (woven wire, deep-drawn or thin sheet).

colourAgainstTheBronze.text: Natural colour of C26000: yellow ('Yellow-Gold' in the colour-matching table); weathered: yellowish, ultimately to grey-green patina. The bronze (tin bronze) is golden with more red.
colourAgainstTheBronze.source: Copper Development Association, A4039, Table 1 and Table 7 (Color-matched Copper Alloys), https://www.copper.org/publications/pub_list/pdf/A4039-ArchitecturalApplications.pdf

formation.how: Copper and zinc are melted together and cast as slabs or billets, then hot and cold rolled to sheet and strip, extruded and drawn to rod and tube, or drawn to wire. Cold work hardens it; annealing softens it again. Wire is woven on a loom into mesh.

density.source: Copper Development Association, A4039, Table 1 ('0.308 lb/in3 (8.53 g/cm3)'), https://www.copper.org/publications/pub_list/pdf/A4039-ArchitecturalApplications.pdf

f0.derivation: Unpolarised Fresnel reflectance at normal incidence, R = ((n-1)^2 + k^2) / ((n+1)^2 + k^2), from the tabulated n,k interpolated linearly to 380-780 nm in 10 nm steps (end values held), integrated against the CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions under CIE illuminant D65, normalised so that a perfect reflector has Y = 1, and converted from XYZ to linear Rec.709 with the sRGB matrix.
f0.source: M. R. Querry, 'Optical constants', Contractor Report CRDC-CR-85034 (1985), https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/citations/ADA158623 , via refractiveindex.info-database other/alloys/Cu-Zn (Querry-Cu70Zn30) ; CIE 018:2019 Table 6, CIE 1931 2-degree colour-matching functions, doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.xvudnb9b ; CIE standard illuminant D65, https://files.cie.co.at/Publications-datasets/CIE_std_illum_D65.csv

f82.derivation: As f0, but the unpolarised Fresnel reflectance of the complex index at 82 degrees incidence (the edge tint of N. Hoffman's F82 model).

photograph: Clean cartridge brass is a clear yellow, visibly yellower than the golden bronze beside it.
Unlacquered brass dulls to a yellow-brown and keeps fingerprints; lacquered brass stays bright until the lacquer breaks, and then tarnishes at the break.
Woven brass mesh reads as a fine yellow grid whose sheen changes with the angle of view as the wires turn.
